description: The GERD study combines GLDAS water-storage information, GRACE solutions, two derived inflow series, precipitation and a precipitation-variability index. This resource is provided by karem abdelmohsen. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists MAT, XLSX formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: These processed remote-sensing and hydrological products are not direct operating records from the dam. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
